image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured, light-colored rocky surface. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct yellow spots and bands. Its head is broad, eyes are visible, and limbs are splayed out, showing digits. The tail curves to the left.
